topic.title: Create a Git Repository from a Project

body.p: When you open the Git Staging view for an project that is not a Git repository, the Git Client can offer to create a local Git repository in the project folder. This prompt is shown when the Ask user to create new repository option is enabled in the Git Client preferences.
You can also create the repository manually. In the Git Staging view toolbar, open the Ellipsis menu, or open the Git main menu, and use the Create repository in project action.
After you create the local repository, you can use it as a local-only repository. If you later push or pull changes, the Git Client prompts you for the remote repository URL.
